thread:
maria_cs: Heads up — Northbridge showing a quiet signal. Usage down ~62% last 30d, renewal in ~45 days, and they've swapped in a new PM. Putting this on my radar for escalation.
ben_se: ugh that's pretty steep. do we have their token-level trend + top routes? link?
olivia_csm: I pulled a quick CSV — primary routes affected: /generate-chat and /embed-batch. Onboarding playbooks were delivered but adoption stalled after phase 1.
maria_cs: paste: `30d tokens: 12,400 -> 4,700 (−62%)`
raj_sales: i heard from procurement contact they're running a competitive pilot with LexaAI for summarization. not sure about scope yet.
tyler_pm: any errors or latency spikes around the drop? could be perf regression or just usage change.
maria_cs: no major errors in Sentry, latency stable. it's more of a behavioral drop when they moved the new PM. they mentioned deprioritizing the ML feature set.
ben_se: ok so product/priority shift + competitor pilot. let's separate root causes: 1) internal stakeholder reprioritization 2) feature fit / quality 3) price or procurement test.
olivia_csm: suggested next steps: 1) short health call with exec sponsor (we have VP product contact) 2) offer a targeted enablement workshop for the new PM 3) collect 3 signal playbooks (top prompts, success metrics, competitor ask).
raj_sales: i'll ask procurement for RFP scope and timeline. if they're testing LexaAI, need to know evaluation endpoints and pricing band.
maria_cs: can support create a one-pager showing delta vs LexaAI on our lat/cost/quality? a one-slide ROI will help.
ben_se: eng, can you run a quick query for request distribution and cache hit rate for Northbridge (last 60d)? markers: prefix cache, batching, kv hit.
tyler_pm: will run and share by EOD. also happy to create a short A/B prompt set to surface regressions vs open models.
support_bot: Ticket #CS-4921 opened for high-touch enablement request. Assigned to olivia_csm.
olivia_csm: scheduling note — VP product available next Tue 11am PT or Thu 3pm PT. prefer 30m exec sync + 60m hands-on workshop with PM/eng.
raj_sales: if we need to protect revenue, i can propose a short pilot discount + SLA for the next quarter while we run the enablement. want to avoid immediate price cuts though.
maria_cs: agree avoid discounts until we confirm it's not purely procurement price testing. plan: schedule exec sync, deliver ROI one-pager, run enablement workshop, get procurement RFP. owners: maria_cs (lead), raj_sales (procurement intel), ben_se (product/metrics), tyler_pm (A/B tests), olivia_csm (workshop).
ben_se: i'll also prepare a short retention playbook we can tailor — includes success metrics, escalation triggers, and a small technical checklist (cache, batching, prompt patterns).
maria_cs: thanks all. i'll create a Loom recap and PRD for the playbook today. tagging @here for visibility. :spiral_calendar: next check-in Thurs after workshop.
raj_sales: noted. sending procurement ask now. :email:
olivia_csm: adding customer feedback form template to the thread so we can capture PM's concerns during the workshop.
maria_cs: final ask — if anyone hears product signal that would materially change our approach (e.g., they plan to deprecate feature), ping me asap. otherwise we execute the playbook and reconvene after sync. :thumbsup:
